description: Batch order tracking (POST /b2b/v1/orders/state). Returns {query_results: [{order_id, query_result, state?}]} — query_result reports per-order lookup success (an unknown id is reported here, not as an HTTP error). Known states: draft, checked_out, reserving, reserved, postpone_reserving, postponed, assembling, assembled, courier_assigned, delivering, closed, pending_cancel, canceled (the list is open-ended).

orders.description: Order ids to check (client-side ids used at creation).

name: get_orders_state
title: Get order states (batch)
